referee_caveats_inferred: The metallicity trend depends on extrapolated 12C/13C and O/H gradients beyond 12-18 kpc, which the paper says are poorly constrained
Kinematic distances at large Rgc carry up to ~40% mass uncertainty and enter alpha_vir directly
Magnetic support is inferred, not measured; no B-field observations of these clouds
Dwarf-galaxy points mix different tracers, resolutions and an assumed density profile for DDO 70
Mixed telescopes and beams (23 to 46 arcsec versus 2 to 3.5 arcsec) sample different physical scales

missing_for_reproduction: ALMA TP imaging parameters and pipeline version
tclean cleaning parameters for archival SMC / NGC 6822 data

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ALMA TP 26 fields: small (<~10 GB); archival SMC and NGC 6822 interferometry: tens of GB raw; reduced cubes on figshare are far smaller
reproducibility.score_reason: Public ALMA and figshare data and a fairly complete equation-level recipe with numeric results, but several inputs are blank-cited and imaging details for the ALMA parts are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA TP and archival data are public, the virial-parameter recipe is given in equations, and the main results (alpha_vir versus Z, fit coefficients) are numeric, though some ancillary inputs are not recoverable from the text.
